title: Logging a trip
description: Record a day on the water — distance, hours, and fuel.

steps.text: Open the Log tab and tap Add Trip.
Use GPS Go/Stop to track it, or enter odometer readings.
Add what you did and any notes.

tips: GPS trips give the most accurate distance and speed.
Trips feed the Year in Review and trip analytics.
affects: Season stats, Year in Review, and the fuel-range brain.
examples: A GPS-logged run to the fishing grounds.
An odometer trip on a day without signal.
